precode_design_clarification.issue: Separate location decoders need not equivary when sensory rows move because recipient-location coefficients differ.
precode_design_clarification.parent_resolution: Shared pooled-seen decoder/normalizer/target means/alpha for local risk_hidden/sensory_hidden/outcomes_only/rawlogit_outcomes/observed_only; per-location only global joint_hidden/route_hidden. Restrict exact permutation to primary structured/local decoders.

preoutput_protocol_semantics_corrections.issue: Initial target was per-channel spatial standard deviation, whereas parent protocol specifies population standard deviation over all 3x16x16 values.
preoutput_protocol_semantics_corrections.resolution: Pooled RGB/spatial image_value_std and explicit varying-RGB constant-plane fixture (nonzero SD, zero gradients). No output-driven target selection.

preoutput_protocol_semantics_corrections.issue: Initial summaries omitted promised risk bins/target moments, and auxiliary decode did not archive continuous score.
preoutput_protocol_semantics_corrections.resolution: Add five fixed current-success bins [.0,.2,.4,.6,.8,1], target mean/population variance, explicit empty groups and continuous uncalibrated 0/1 answer_score thresholded at .5. Physical targets alone select alpha.

synthetic_fixture_runs.integration_fixture_scope: Toy image-only sensor, randomly initialized fixture networks, 24/12/24 worlds, 8 world bootstraps; full collection/probe/calibration-selection/assessment/intervention/archive replay in temporary directory.

implementation_boundaries: Only calibrated model weights/normalizers/calibration key consumed from existing compressed instruments; no old per-world forecasts/labels used.
World truth is separate archive/evaluator-only stratification; latest delivered images define objective physical targets.
Missing unseen physical targets use archive-only zero placeholders masked out of all fits/assessments.
Shared local and per-location global decoder budgets differ and are explicitly reported.
Physical targets and auxiliary raw-answer agreement cannot earn qualitative presentation or consciousness acceptance.
Single exclusive attempt/failure preservation and exact collection/refit/archive/result replay are implemented.
